import hashlib,json,re,shutil,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();mutants=[]
def data(n,name):return root/'data/openjudge/tests'/('20000-29982' if n<30000 else '30000-')/f'{n}_made'/name
suite='tests.test_gmyhf_missing_normal_data'
mutants.extend([(data(27207,'samplecode.py'),'重复前体不能去重','sum(costs[v] for v in ingredients)','sum(costs[v] for v in set(ingredients))',suite),
 (data(29337,'samplecode.py'),'零元素计数不能丢','for value in nums:','for value in nums:\n        if value==0:continue',suite),
 (data(29893,'samplecode.py'),'车站编号不能前移','coefficients(x)','coefficients(x-1)',suite),
 (data(29894,'samplecode.py'),'重复题独立车站答案','coefficients(x)','coefficients(x-1)',suite),
 (data(31178,'samplecode.py'),'字符串不可改为常量',"def solve(text):","def solve(text):\n    return 'Hello, OJ Inject!'",suite),
 (data(31200,'samplecode.py'),'区间必须包含右端点','range(a,b+1)','range(a,b)',suite)])
for n in (27207,29337,29893,29894,31178,31200):mutants.append((data(n,'producecase.py'),f'{n}拒绝非法输入','def valid(text):','def valid(text):\n    return True',suite))
p=root/'scripts/gmyhf_io_benchmark_data.py';b='tests.test_gmyhf_io_benchmark_data'
mutants.extend([(p,'不能截短300万行','COUNT = 3_000_000','COUNT = 2_999_999',b),
 (p,'逐行校验不能全放行','def validate_file(path):','def validate_file(path):\n    return True',b),
 (p,'性能参考不能漏字节','sys.stdout.buffer.write(block)','sys.stdout.buffer.write(block[:-1])',b)])
p=root/'scripts/upload_gmyhf_missing_data.py';u='tests.test_gmyhf_missing_data_upload'
mutants.extend([(p,'默认计划不得上传','if not apply:return report','if False:return report',u),
 (p,'完整文件清单检查','set(names)==expected_names','True',u),
 (p,'既有文件内容不能覆盖','common.sha(common.platform.download(session,number,name))==hashes[name]','True',u),
 (p,'平台文件必须选中',"selected[f'filenames[{name}]']='1'","selected[f'filenames[{name}]']='0'",u)])
original={p:p.read_bytes() for p,*_ in mutants};results=[]
try:
 for p,label,old,new,suite in mutants:
  source=original[p].decode();assert old in source,label
  mutated=source.replace(old,new);p.write_text(mutated+'\n# 变异自检：'+label+'\n')
  shutil.rmtree(p.parent/'__pycache__',ignore_errors=True)
  try:
   proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-m','unittest',suite],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
   if not proc.returncode:raise ValueError('变异未检出:'+label)
   if 'SyntaxError' in proc.stderr or 'ImportError' in proc.stderr:raise ValueError('无效变异:'+label+' '+proc.stderr[-500:])
   results.append({'mutation':label,'detected':True,'source':str(p.relative_to(root)),'exit_code':proc.returncode});print(label,'已检出',flush=True)
  finally:p.write_bytes(original[p]);shutil.rmtree(p.parent/'__pycache__',ignore_errors=True)
finally:
 for p,payload in original.items():p.write_bytes(payload);shutil.rmtree(p.parent/'__pycache__',ignore_errors=True)
(root/'collab/gmyhf-missing-data-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'results':results,'restored_sources_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest() for p,v in original.items()},'procedure_source':Path(__file__).read_text()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')

import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();p=root/'scripts/materialize_gmyhf_downloads.py';original=p.read_bytes();source=original.decode();assert source.count('if oversized:')==1
try:
 p.write_text(source.replace('if oversized:','if False:')+'\n# 变异：跳过性能题输出上限\n')
 run=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_io_benchmark_data.IoBenchmarkDataTests.test_future_mapping_still_excludes_full_size_benchmark_outputs'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
 assert run.returncode!=0 and 'SyntaxError' not in run.stderr and 'ImportError' not in run.stderr
finally:p.write_bytes(original)
report=root/'collab/gmyhf-missing-data-mutations.json';d=json.loads(report.read_text());d['results'].append({'mutation':'性能题未来有映射也不能绕过2MiB上限','detected':True,'source':str(p.relative_to(root)),'exit_code':run.returncode});d['restored_sources_sha256'][str(p.relative_to(root))]=hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest();d['benchmark_guard_procedure_source']=Path(__file__).read_text();report.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print('第20种变异已检出；源码已恢复')
